info.title: csharpc — a C# compiler front-end for LLVM
info.description: csharpc: a C# compiler front-end for LLVM (Roslyn -> LLVM IR -> native). RID-specific NativeAOT tool; install with dotnet tool install -g csharpc.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file, or directory (trailing '/' or existing dir) for <AssemblyName>

options.name: -p
options.description: MSBuild global property used when evaluating a project

options.name: --emit
options.description: exe (default) | obj | asm | llvm-ir | llvm-bc

options.name: -O0
options.description: Optimization level (default: -O2)

options.name: -Os
options.description: Optimize for size (-Oz: smallest), at -O2 speed otherwise

options.name: --no-strip
options.description: Strip symbols from the executable (default: strip unless -g)

options.name: --static
options.description: Link a fully static executable (no shared libc at run time)

options.name: --debug
options.description: Emit DWARF debug info (C# source-level debugging with gdb/lldb)

options.name: -g0
options.description: No debug info (default)

options.name: --target
options.description: Target triple (default: host)

options.name: --cpu
options.description: Target CPU: native, x86-64-v3, znver4, ... (default: best x86-64-vN the host supports; host CPU on AArch64)

options.name: --features
options.description: Extra LLVM target features, e.g. +avx512f

options.name: -D
options.description: Define a preprocessor symbol

options.name: --reference
options.description: Reference an assembly that ships only IL; reachable code is compiled from its IL

options.name: --framework-il
options.description:
'none' turns off the automatic choice (assemblies the program uses that
csharpc's corelib does not implement)

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Also reference this shared framework, like <FrameworkReference> in a project
(Microsoft.AspNetCore.App); its assemblies are compiled from IL

options.name: --corelib
options.description:
Lower the corelib from its precompiled IL (cached) or bind its C# sources
(default: il, or $CSHARPC_CORELIB)

options.name: --no-implicit-usings
options.description: Don't add the SDK's implicit global usings

options.name: --no-runtime-lto
options.description: Link the runtime as objects instead of LTO-ing its bitcode

options.name: --gc-nursery
options.description:
Emit heap write barriers and enable the non-moving nursery by default
(also CSHARPC_GC_NURSERY=1; off by default — see docs/adr/0004)

options.name: --stack-traces
options.description:
Record stack traces in every program (default: only programs that print
an exception or read Exception.StackTrace)

options.name: --hardening
options.description: none | default (full RELRO, NX, stack probes, hardened runtime) | max (+ CET IBT/SHSTK or BTI/PAC, SLH)

options.name: --sanitize
options.description: Build the runtime with sanitizers, e.g. address,undefined (testing; $CSHARPC_SANITIZE)

options.name: --cc
options.description: C compiler used as linker driver (default: $CSHARPC_CC or clang)

options.name: --dump-cfg
options.description: Print Roslyn's control-flow graphs (csharpc's "MIR")

options.name: --dump-il
options.description: Print the IL blocks of methods compiled from IL

options.name: --il-survey
options.description: The same, for these IL assemblies only (comma-separated)

options.name: --il-survey-shard
options.description: Survey only the types in shard i of n (by a stable hash of the type name)

options.name: --intrinsics
options.description: List the library members csharpc implements

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Threads one compilation may use (default: $CSHARPC_THREADS or the processor count)

options.name: -W
options.description: Show Roslyn warnings

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print pipeline phases and timings

options.name: --version
options.description: Print version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help
